subject: Control inventory & access narrative for ClearWave SIG intake
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ClearWave Security Team <security@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ kickoff — SCIM delta, role descriptions, and 'least privilege' narrative

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. As part of our procurement loop we need a concise control inventory and an "access narrative" that explains how Redwood enforces least-privilege for ClearWave's tenant. Specifically the security team asked for: lists of RBAC roles with sample SAML assertions, a SCIM delta snapshot showing recent provisioning activity, and a short narrative (1 page max) describing role assignment and approval flow.

We'd like to bundle these into the SIG Lite intake (CAIQ fields) — is it possible to deliver a bundle by Friday 2026-07-09 EOD PT? If not, please propose a two-step deliverable (technical artifacts first, narrative second).

Attached is the SIG intake template the customer uses (they call it the "ClearWave SIG Lite checklist"). Let me know if you need more detail on the expected attribute names for SCIM or SAML.

Regards,
Laura Chen
Head of Security Programs
ClearWave Health

Attachments: clearwave_sig_template.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ kickoff — SCIM delta, role descriptions, and 'least privilege' narrative

Laura — thanks, we can get a staged delivery. Plan:

1) Technical artifact bundle by Thu 2026-07-08 18:00 PT — includes sample SAML assertions, SCIM delta snapshot, and our RBAC role mapping CSV.
2) Access narrative + control inventory (1-page narrative + CAIQ mappings) by Fri 2026-07-09 17:00 PT.

Marissa, can you own the role mapping CSV and the narrative? Jonas — can you pull the SCIM delta and SAML assertion samples from the tenant logs and redact any PII? I will assemble the SIG checklist mapping and produce the CAIQ field responses.

If ClearWave prefers the artifacts delivered to their secure share instead of email, we'll use the Drive folder and add the security team with viewer access.

Karthik
Director, Security & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments (incoming): none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ kickoff — SCIM delta, role descriptions, and 'least privilege' narrative

Quick status:

- SCIM delta: exported a snapshot from the provisioning service for tenant clearwave-prod for the window 2026-06-30..2026-07-07. Redacted email addresses where required and replaced with hashed identifiers. Saved as scim_delta_snapshot.json (see Drive link).
- SAML assertions: collected three representative assertion samples (login, role-change event, and assertion with group claims). Samples include attribute names used by our IdP: nameid, email, groups, role_claim. Files: saml_assertions_sample.txt
- RBAC role mapping: drafted a CSV with 8 roles (admin, billing_admin, data_reader, customer_support, integrations, model_ops, dev_lead, read_only). Each row has role name, description, provisioning source, approval flow, and least-privilege justification. File: clearwave_sig_matrix.csv

Notes on least-privilege enforcement:
- Role assignment requires manager approval in our internal IAM console for non-standard roles; standard roles are auto-provisioned via SCIM when assigned in the customer's IdP group mapping.
- We log provisioning events and emit a daily SCIM delta used by audits; last 90 days of delta logs are retained in the audit bucket.

I'll upload the artifacts to the clearwave Drive folder and add the link to the CAIQ mapping doc. Marissa — if you want, use my detailed attribute mapping in the role_mapping_readme.pdf when writing the narrative.

Jonas
Senior Reliability Engineer — Identity

Attachments: scim_delta_snapshot.json, saml_assertions_sample.txt, clearwave_sig_matrix.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverables: ClearWave SIG intake artifacts and access narrative

Hi Laura — delivering the artifacts we discussed. Summary below and attachments are in the shared Drive folder (link included).

What we delivered:
- Artifact bundle (technical): clearwave_sig_matrix.csv, saml_assertions_sample.txt, scim_delta_snapshot.json — these show role definitions, provisioning samples, and a one-week SCIM delta as requested.
- Control narrative (operational): role_mapping_readme.pdf — 1-page narrative describing assignment, approval flow, and least-privilege controls plus where logs are retained.
- CAIQ mapping: populated the SIG Lite fields and attached a completed CSV mapping to each CAIQ control.

Short answers to your specific asks:
- SCIM attribute names: we include id, externalId, userName, name (given/family), emails, active, groups. The delta snapshot shows adds/updates/removes.
- SAML attributes: nameid, email, groups, role_claim. Assertion samples show how we consume group-to-role mappings.
- Least-privilege justification: roles are minimized; any role granting write access to production data requires approval by a named owner and is logged. Periodic entitlement reviews are run quarterly; owners receive reminders 30 days before review due date.

Next steps: please confirm if you'd like us to up-level any artifact (e.g., full 90-day delta or raw audit logs) — we can provide via secure share once we have a PO or NDA in place for raw logs. Otherwise, let us know if the SIG Lite package is sufficient for procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_clearwave_sig
Attachments delivered: clearwave_sig_matrix.csv, saml_assertions_sample.txt, scim_delta_snapshot.json, role_mapping_readme.pdf
